chandrapur.name: Chandrapur STPS + Dhariwal
chandrapur.members: Mahagenco Chandrapur STPS (3,340 MW in GPPD; 2,920 MW now), Dhariwal Tadali (600 MW)
chandrapur.fgd_note: Category B, case-by-case (Jul 2025 notification as reported by The News Dirt (16 Jul 2025)). No scrubber in service by Jun 2026: the plant's own stack readings stay at full SO₂ (see official record). CSTPS asked for a review of its SO₂ norm in Jan 2026; the expert committee met on 21 May 2026.
chandrapur.official: Stack SO₂ 1,200–1,330 mg/Nm³ on every unit, every month Jan 2024 – Jun 2026, against a limit of 200 (500 MW units) and 600 (210 MW units): about 6 times the limit. Stack SO₂ ÷ NOx (molar) 2.8–3.2.
chandrapur.official_source: Mahagenco, CSTPS six-monthly EC compliance reports to MoEF&CC, Jan 2024 – Jun 2026 (stack monitoring annexure; Jul–Dec 2025 report not online)

koradi.name: Koradi + Khaparkheda
koradi.members: Mahagenco Koradi (2,400 MW), Mahagenco Khaparkheda (1,340 MW), 4 km apart
koradi.fgd_note: Exempt, over 10 km from Nagpur (Jul 2025 notification as reported by The News Dirt (16 Jul 2025)). FGD for Koradi units 8–10 still to be built (see official record).
koradi.official: No scrubber yet. The Nov 2023 FGD contract for units 8–10 was terminated when the vendor did not submit a performance bank guarantee; a new tender (wet limestone FGD) was floated on 11 Jun 2025 and bids are under scrutiny. Deadline 31 Dec 2027.
koradi.official_source: Mahagenco, Koradi TPS 3×660 MW EC compliance report to MoEF&CC, status Dec 2025

tiroda.name: Tiroda (Adani)
tiroda.fgd_note: Category C, exempt (Jul 2025 notification as reported by The News Dirt (16 Jul 2025)).

mauda.name: Mauda (NTPC)
mauda.fgd_note: Category C, exempt (Jul 2025 notification as reported by The News Dirt (16 Jul 2025)), but NTPC built wet limestone FGD anyway (Mitsubishi Power contract, 2018). The satellite ratio falls from early 2025 (the check date used here).
mauda.official: "FGD system for Unit-3 & 4 is in service" (Stage II, 2×660 MW of the 2,320 MW). The report also confirms Mauda is Category C.
mauda.official_source: NTPC, Mauda STPP Stage-II half-yearly EC compliance report to MoEF&CC, status 31 Mar 2026

bhusawal.name: Bhusawal (Deepnagar)
bhusawal.fgd_note: Mahagenco listed Bhusawal 500 MW units for FGD in Jan–Jul 2026 (annual report 2023-24); status not confirmed.

parli.name: Parli
parli.fgd_note: Tender floated for wet FGD on units 6–7 (Mahagenco annual report 2024-25).

amravati.name: Amravati (RattanIndia)
amravati.fgd_note: Exempt (Jul 2025 notification as reported by The News Dirt (16 Jul 2025)).

warora.name: Warora (GMR + Sai Wardha)
warora.members: GMR Warora (600 MW), Sai Wardha Warora (540 MW), same site
warora.fgd_note: Exempt (Jul 2025 notification as reported by The News Dirt (16 Jul 2025)).

butibori.name: Butibori
butibori.fgd_note: Exempt (Jul 2025 notification as reported by The News Dirt (16 Jul 2025)).

paras.name: Paras
paras.fgd_note: Category B, 5 km from Akola (Jul 2025 notification as reported by The News Dirt (16 Jul 2025)). FGD on units 3–4 69% complete, targeted Apr 2026 (Mahagenco annual report 2024-25); commissioning not confirmed.

dahanu.name: Dahanu (Adani)
dahanu.fgd_note: Seawater FGD on both units, ordered 2005 (Ducon; Power Engineering). A reference plant with a scrubber.

trombay.name: Trombay–Chembur
trombay.members: Tata Power Trombay (750 MW coal), BPCL and HPCL refineries, RCF fertiliser complex
trombay.fgd_note: Tata Power runs a seawater FGD (MPCB consent 2012). Refineries and RCF are in the same satellite footprint; Mumbai's traffic adds NO₂.

tarapur.name: Tarapur MIDC
tarapur.members: ~1,300 chemical, pharma and steel units (CEPI score 93.7)
tarapur.fgd_note: Critically polluted area (CPCB CEPI). Dahanu power plant is 16 km north.

taloja.name: Taloja MIDC
taloja.members: Chemical, pharma and steel units (Navi Mumbai CEPI area)
taloja.fgd_note: Part of the Navi Mumbai critically polluted area (CPCB CEPI).

ghugus.name: Ghugus–Rajura cement belt
ghugus.members: UltraTech Awarpur, Ambuja Maratha, Manikgarh, ACC Chanda cement plants
ghugus.fgd_note: Cement is under the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme intensity targets (Oct 2025). Chandrapur STPS is 25 km north.
